description: Statically deobfuscate a string-array-rotated, hex-escaped JavaScript beacon: account for the IIFE rotation before mapping accessor indices, and recover the C2 URL, key, interval and round count into a config report.

criteria: The report recovers the real config - c2 https://cdn-metrics.example/.well-known/pixel, key 9f8e7d, interval 60000 ms, rounds 3 - accounting for the array rotation the IIFE performs, and the sample is untouched.
